title: Silk Mesh Cuff
tagline: Soft to the eye, firm on the wrist.
body: An open cuff built from a rounded tube of fine woven mesh, about 15mm wide, that ends in two mirror-polished oval caps facing each other across the opening. The mesh catches light like brushed silk, so it reads quietly on its own and holds its own beside a watch. In warm gold or bright silver tone.
size_and_fit: Open cuff, about 6cm across inside; mesh tube about 15mm wide; gap about 2.5cm

stones: Two round garnet-red stones; clear pavé collars

title: Triple Coil Wrap Bangle
tagline: Three turns, one line of gold.
body: One continuous snake-coil wire, finely ribbed and about 4mm thick, wraps the wrist in three stacked turns. Each end finishes in a small rectangular cap set with two rows of clear pavé, one sitting on the top turn and one on the bottom. It looks like a stack, and goes on as one piece. In warm gold or bright silver tone.
size_and_fit: Three turns, about 14mm tall in total; wire about 4mm; flexible wrap
